verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting is well documented for alerting on metrics, logs and traces across multiple data sources from one consolidated view, and community users praise its multi-datasource alerting. Notifications go to Slack, PagerDuty, OpsGenie and similar tools, and Grafana Cloud adds on-call escalation, which covers basic routing. Notification grouping and silencing, both explicit parts of the story, are not evidenced anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: evidence of notification grouping, silencing/muting of alerts, label-based routing policies, independent hands-on corroboration of routing behavior.
